name: Orbit Headline
description: Parametric reconstruction of an After Effects headline: words scale in one after another and drift along shallow arcs under a slow group zoom, staying upright throughout. Curves are ported from the original Bodymovin export, so any duration keeps the source's timing character.

params.label: Headline
params.description: The headline. Split into words automatically; a "|" starts a new phrase that replaces the previous one, so "You talk | I'll listen" plays as two phrases and "Ship it" as one.

params.label: Font
params.description: Any font installed where the render runs. The original used the commercial Widescreen-Bold, which is not available here; Archivo Black is the closest wide, heavy grotesque, and it falls back to Arial Black then sans-serif.

params.label: Duration (s)
params.description: The source is 5.6s (168 frames at 30fps). Every curve is normalised, so other durations stretch or compress proportionally rather than clipping.

params.label: Group zoom
params.description: Scales the source's 0.97x-to-1.61x push. 1 reproduces it, 0 holds the block still, 2 doubles the travel.

params.label: Orbit drift
params.description: Scales the arc each word travels (the source sweeps -29deg to +40deg about the centre). 0 keeps the words on their layout positions.

params.label: Rotation settle (deg)
params.description: Off by default, because the source keeps every word perfectly upright - its per-frame rotation keys are counter-rotation of the rig, not a wobble. Non-zero adds a decaying rotational settle on entry as an artistic option.

params.label: Word stagger (s)
params.description: Delay between word entrances within a phrase (the source uses 3.5 frames, about 0.12s). Capped automatically so short durations still leave every word time to arrive.
